story.originalTitle: "It was good to hear from Ryō, as the last time he gave feedback was before our update, so he confirmed what our drivers have been saying about consi...
story.summaryEn:
"It was good to hear from Ryō, as the last time he gave feedback was before our update, so he confirmed what our drivers have been saying about consistency, predictability, and stability of the package." 🗣️ AK
Friday wrapped in Mexico City 🇲🇽
#HaasF1 #F1 #MexicoGP
detailZh:
“很高兴收到Ryō的消息，因为上一次他提供反馈是在我们更新之前，所以他确认了我们车手们关于套件一致性、可预测性和稳定性的说法。” 🗣️ AK
周五在墨西哥城结束 🇲🇽
#HaasF1 #F1 #MexicoGP
detailEn:
"It was good to hear from Ryō, as the last time he gave feedback was before our update, so he confirmed what our drivers have been saying about consistency, predictability, and stability of the package." 🗣️ AK
Friday wrapped in Mexico City 🇲🇽
#HaasF1 #F1 #MexicoGP
